blurb: The Lynwood Natatorium is located between the Lynwood Community Center and St. Francis Medical Center. First opened in 1953 this indoor, heated, 50-meter "Olympic size" swim facility offers an enclosed sun deck, separate dressing areas and a one-meter diving stand along with a friendly staff.
